tuto.welcome:
Welcome to the <bold>Verso</bold> tutorial!
Your goal is to score as many victory points as possible by banking sequences of cards or forming squares.
tuto.deck:
Here is the Verso deck.
In <bold>Verso</bold>, each card has 2 faces, and they are always different.
tuto.card: This card is blue (sea) and its value is 4.
tuto.points:
It is worth 1 victory point.
A card is always worth 1 victory point on one face, and 3 victory points on the other face.
tuto.verso: Moreover, the reverse of a card is always a different color. The reverse of this blue card is therefore either green (land) or orange (sky).
tuto.flip:
Finally, the value of a card is always 1 higher or 1 lower on the reverse.
The reverse of this card is therefore necessarily a 3 or a 5.
Flip the card.
tuto.place:
The reverse of this card is an orange 5, worth 3 victory points.
On your turn, if you choose to flip the top card of the deck, you must add it to your playing area.
tuto.playerlayout:
This is your playing area.
You can never have 2 cards of the same color and the same value. If you were to get another orange 5, it would immediately be discarded.
tuto.opponent: It is your opponent’s turn to play.
tuto.opponent.place: Your opponent added this card to their playing area without flipping it.
tuto.place.without.flip: It is your turn. Add this card to your playing area, without flipping it.
tuto.choose.action:
It is your turn again.
On your turn, you choose ONE of these 2 actions:
• draw a card
• bank a sequence of cards
tuto.sequence: A sequence is a line of 2 to 6 cards <bold>of the same color</bold> whose values are <bold>consecutive</bold>.
tuto.bank.validate: When you bank a sequence, you score as many points as <bold>the number of victory points at the top of the cards</bold> forming the sequence.
tuto.bank.discard: After banking a sequence, <bold>you discard the 2 highest value cards of that sequence</bold>.
tuto.bank.flip:
Finally, when you bank a sequence, your opponent must flip their highest value card in that color.
<bold>If the flipped card has the same color and the same value as a card they already have, they discard it!</bold>
<italic>With 4 players or more, only your 2 immediate neighbors flip a card.</italic>
tuto.joker: This card is a joker. It takes the value of your choice in a sequence!
tuto.score:
There are 2 ways to score points in Verso:
• bank a sequence
• form a square of 9 cards (3 of each color)
tuto.square:
As soon as you have at least 3 cards of each color, you immediately score 7 victory points.
You must then undo your square (for example by banking a sequence) before you can score 7 victory points again.
tuto.end: The game ends as soon as the deck is empty. Each player can then bank one final sequence of cards.
tuto.go:
Now it is your turn to play: will you bank a sequence, or draw a card? Will you flip it before taking it?
Good luck!
rules.solo.text.1: Each turn, you must choose either to draw a card OR bank a sequence.
rules.solo.text.2: Following your turn, you simulate an opponent taking their turn by flipping the top card of the deck to reveal its reverse side.
rules.solo.text.3: If one of the faces on your opponent’s card is a joker: Nothing happens.
rules.solo.text.4: If the number on the reverse side of your opponent’s card is higher than the number on the side initially visible: Flip your highest numbered card in the same color as the reverse side.
rules.solo.text.5: Finally, discard your opponent’s card and play your next turn.
